classification.difficultyReason: Infer enclosing dimensions from margins and opening dimensions, then subtract the appropriate rectangular or triangular openings from the enclosing area.

content.prompt: Find the area of the shaded region in each figure below by adding and subtracting the areas of squares, rectangles and triangles as necessary.

spec.description: Outer square and tilted inner square; all eight boundary segments retain their single or double equality ticks. Ordinary blue source strokes become black.
spec.mathematics: Outer side 12+5 metres. Four shaded right triangles have perpendicular sides 12 metres and 5 metres.
spec.answerVisibility: All givens visible; no answer shown. Light blue identifies precisely the requested shaded region.

shadingDecision.reason: Shading identifies the four regions whose combined area is requested.

answer.worked:
The shaded region consists of four congruent right triangles.
$$\begin{align*}A_{\text{triangle}}&=\tfrac12\times12\times5\\A_{\text{triangle}}&=30\ \mathrm{m}^2\\A_{\text{shaded}}&=4\times30\\A_{\text{shaded}}&=120\ \mathrm{m}^2\end{align*}$$
